page.title: Component Toolkit Kit
page.descLead: General-purpose capabilities picked from two local legacy projects (old mobile / old tablet), decoupled from business logic and rewritten as React 19 + antd 5 components.
page.descTail: The full research list (what was chosen, why, and what was skipped) is in

display.ellipsisDesc: Single line uses nowrap + ellipsis, multi-line uses -webkit-line-clamp. The original binary-search, character-by-character measurement is unnecessary on browsers that support line-clamp, so it was removed entirely.
display.countdownDesc: The original decremented once per second, so a throttled background tab accumulated drift; here each tick recomputes with Date.now(), correcting immediately when the tab returns to the foreground.
display.countdownCardLabel: Card style (target: 2 hours 45 minutes from now)
display.statTitle: Stat card (red for up, green for down)
display.statDesc: Merges the original project's NumberInfo + Trend. Colors follow the domestic convention — up in red, down in green; pass colorMode="us" when you need Western colors.
display.timelineDesc: The original depended on G2 + g2-plugin-slider (and generated domId with Math.random(), which is inconsistent under React 19 strict mode double-invocation); ECharts' dataZoom is built in, so the bottom zoom bar + wheel zoom are configured once.
display.noticeDesc: Merges the original project's NoticeIcon and Cart (90% duplicated). The clear button supports a second confirmation — just make onClear return a Promise.

stat.assetFooter: Data center has the highest share

form.tagDesc: Space / Enter / comma (half- or full-width) all submit; pressing Backspace with an empty input removes the previous tag; pasting "A, B C" splits into three tags at once. Up to 6.
form.asyncDesc: Requests only on first expand or when typing a keyword (lazy loading) + 300ms debounce + request race protection. Supports field mapping via fields and custom option rendering.
form.timerangeDesc: Keeps the original three validations (end after start / single segment within limit / no overlap between segments) and adds a hint for incomplete start-end input; total hours are computed in real time.

inter.signDesc: Canvas handwriting + high-DPI + undo / clear / export PNG. Drops the react-canvas-draw dependency, and lays down a white background on export (otherwise a transparent PNG turns black in image viewers).
inter.pullDesc: Damping factor 2.5, threshold 56px. Triggers only when every scrollable ancestor is at the top, using overscroll-behavior: contain instead of preventDefault.
inter.infiniteDesc: Uses IntersectionObserver instead of hand-written scroll listeners; the sentinel node stays mounted, and while loading only one extra line of text is rendered below. Loaded {loaded}/36 items.
inter.sortDesc: Zero-dependency (the original react-sortable-hoc is incompatible with React 19). Drag by the handle; once the handle is focused, ↑ / ↓ keys also move the item.
inter.marqueeDesc: Starts only when the content really exceeds the container width; animation duration = overflow pixels / speed, so long text does not scroll faster.
inter.ballDesc: Position persists as the **ratio** of "left / (screen width - ball width)", so it stays sensible after rotation or window resize. Snaps to the nearest edge on release; click to return to the top of the page.

ball.hint: The snapped position will be shown here after dragging

pull.tipDrag: Pull down to try (mouse drag works too)
pull.tipRefresh: Refresh inserts a new record at the top

data.longText: The asset lifecycle management platform covers procurement review, installation acceptance, routine inspection, preventive maintenance, metrology calibration, fault repair, benefit analysis and disposal. A missing record at any stage affects asset status judgment and compliance auditing, so every operation must be settled into a traceable electronic archive.
